name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 25 2020
information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak.# This is the 25th edition of Bay Area Speedcubin'! Come join us at SI for classic speedcubin' and some new twists! **Competition Day Timing** * The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. * Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will **not** start more than 20 minutes before the scheduled time. * Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss the last call for that event. In general, the last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
